Added: Gave Elemental suit a unique passive.

Change: Modding API updated, you can now enable mods independently with the ini file in the game folder.
Change: The chosen upgrades on the right side HUD will raise and lower if you have so many that it would be normally obscured by the HUD and go offscreen.

Buff: Bee damage increased, VERSION > (5 + (VERSION * 2)).

Fix: Beating a run with 0 skills equipped would make the collection display a ??? instead of showing the stat.
Fix: Angel Wings, Demon Horns and Plasma Orb all relied on 'nearest x enemy' code which meant that if there was (for example) 15 enemies and you had 30 of the upgrade, 15 would be applied appropriately and then the other 15 would ALL go on the very last instanced enemy. This has been changed to a 'wrap' that wraps back to the very first enemy and spreads them all out evenly, so now they'd ALL be hit by 2 evenly.
Fix: For some reason the very first dialog that Infected Izu is meant to say when you first find them wasn't ever being said! This whole time. Oopsies. It's been reenabled now, but this is the interaction if anyone was curious:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xoMVs2K.png[/img]

Also, for these next changes, I ran a poll asking if people would prefer if C4 and Shrapnel were more limited but hit harder so they could use it without it inevitably bringing down framerate. People seemed to like the idea, so these are the changes:

Buff: C4 damage increased, 10 + (VERSION) > 40 + (VERSION)
Nerf: C4 explosions count limited to 2 * Version. (So Version 10 can have 20 explosions).
Buff: Shrapnel damage increased, (2 * VERSION) > 25 + (2 * VERSION)
Nerf: Shrapnel count limited to 3 * Version. (So Version 10 can have 30 shards).

I'll be keeping a close eye on the reception to the changes and if you feel they need to be adjusted further, please let me know! Hope everyone has been doing well! <3

notes.title: Picayune Dreams: Contamination
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/7b090e7652800bfb8df717cf4f74102815432cc8.jpg[/img]

[i]Stepford, here! The update is out. Sorry it took a hot minute, but I really hope you will enjoy what we've been cooking up. If you have any issues, have any bugs or crashes or just questions, please come join the [url=https://discord.gg/vk5sNFVAXM]Discord[/url] and make a post about it so I can fix it ASAP! Thank you all for the love and support. ːGunfireRebornloveː ːNekoː [/i]

[h2]— - Added:[/h2]
Added: New weapons!
Added: New bosses!
Added: New skills!
Added: New suits?
Added: New achievements!
Added: New songs!
Added: Freeplay Mode.
Added: Just like Dailies, there is now a Monthlies mode for longer term bragging.
Added: 3 new area modifiers. 
Added: 4 new tiers of Skulls, Gloves, Fish and Souls. The last one being an 'infinitely scaling' one.
Added: A new statue.
Added: 3 new basic enemies.
Added: You can now prestige your Profile Level, raising the level cap by 1 and increase all Profile XP by +10%.
Added: The ability to randomize the song. (Setting unlocks after you've beaten a run, make sure it doesn't clash with other binds you have set.)
Added: ANTILAG autoscaling system that grows stronger if your FPS starts to dip. The higher the number, the more unnecessary details are removed.
Added: Quick Restart, unlocks after you've beaten a run.
Added: Some new stats in the Death Screen.
Added: Borderless Windowed option.
Added: Mute If Focus Lost option. 
Added: A new auto upgrade option to automatically choose an option if all three are already owned.
Added: A new auto upgrade option that makes it prioritize the HIGHEST.
Added: You can now block all controller input with a setting.
Added: You can now adjust the dialog speed.
Added: You can now see if your run is Flawless by looking at the Tab Menu mid-run.
Added: The game will now make backups of your save periodically.
Added: Some more stats to the collection.
Added: Extra names to credits.

[h2]— - Change:[/h2]
Change: Tons of various performance enhancements.
Change: You can now play Overdrive scaling up infinitely, getting more and more skill points.
Change: Dailies/monthlies now have a max 30 skill point limit, to make some of the other changes non-destructive to the gamemode integrity.
Change: The game will better acknowledge that you've got the maximum experience and are at the max profile level, and ready to prestige (if you want).
Change: Passives can now go down to 1% instead of capping at 20% minimum.
Change: Made Gamepad aiming feel less garbage.
Change: The damage stat on the sidebar midrun is replaced with an 'average' DPS, total damage is still present in the endscreen.
Change: Some bosses have less health.
Change: Some bosses have more health.
Change: If you have seen the true ending, the main menu music will now always be changed to the alternate theme. 
Change: Just like the final boss, all bosses will now automatically reduce your weapon visibility and then return it to the default after the fight is over.
Change: Newly purchased upgrades move to the bottom of the list, to make them easier to see in situations with lots of upgrades.
Change: Statues will now show their contents at a much further distance.
Change: Flawless boss kills without the use of blackholes are 'True Flawless'.
Change: Exploding Enemies modifier no longer spawns bullets on death, rather the AOE effect itself is what can hurt you.
Change: Exploding Enemies explosions get slightly smaller per chain reaction, to avoid multiplicative scenarios. 
Change: Added an indicator circle for when the Demon boss will teleport.
Change: Since the Amnesia perk has been made redundant, it's been dealt with appropriately. 
Change: Memory USBs will now appear in the loadout as long as you have 1 kill on the boss that drops them. This should fix any issues people have had with them missing/skipping them accidentally or killing two bosses for the first time in one run.
Change: Undying Horror Ghost will no longer be obscured by anything.
Change: Enemy Immortality frames upon spawning are now influenced by GameSpeed. 
Change: By default, ‘Auto Upgrade at Full Build’ will now selectively choose upgrades that are the lowest of the three, to make your entire build more rounded and even.
Change: Lowered intensity of 2x GameSpeed visual effect.
Change: Dailies no longer make HTTP requests to get timezone data.
Change: Tab Menu stats will draw over chosen upgrades and banned upgrades.
Change: Children of killed Skull parents spawn with less immortality time.
Change: Fixed a bug where the Daily would say you have already attempted it, even if you hadn't.
Change: Fixed the Canister misspelling.
Change: XP Cans can now be picked up by Parasights with the appropriate skill.
Change: Fixed XP Cans sometimes not having XP_MOD applied to them.
Change: Removed move speed Worm and Biker get from bonus speed that Cyl gets.
Change: Statue of Discipline now costs Blackholes, and can be used multiple times.
Change: Statue of Potential can be used 3 times.
Change: Magnets pickups will also check to see if XP Cans exist to see if they should be spawned, instead of just XP drops.
Change: Grenades be added to the pickup pool if the player is near a statue.
Change: Curse doesn't increase Boss HP as much.
Change: Monthlies and Dailies will tell you if you've got debug cheat mode on.
Change: Statues should 'slow down' at a further distance.
Change: Droid Enemy bullet speed halved.
Change: Sniper Enemy bullet speed halved.
Change: Droid Enemy bullet lifetime doubled.
Change: Sniper Enemy bullet lifetime doubled.

[h2]— - Stat/Upgrade Adjustments:[/h2]
Nerf: ([i]The most important change to know, so I’ll put it here first![/i]) Halo no longer blocks bullets, just contact damage.
Buff: Solenoid Infusion now gives +3% XP Radius instead of +1%.
Buff: Skull Crushing Distance scales with bosses killed.
Buff: Gimmiko Dice scale with bosses killed.
Buff: XP dropped by bosses should be much higher.
Buff: Turret turn speed is now influenced by Proj Spd.
Buff: Turret firerate increase, 15 CD > 10 CD.
Change: Turrets will aim at the nearest enemy to you, instead of themselves.
Buff: Core now gains +1 damage per version.
Buff: Ultrabuster now gains +1 damage per version.
Buff: Headphones damage increase, 15 > 20.
Buff: Headphones knockback increase, 0.5 > 1.
Buff: Soul Spear damage increase, 45 > 50.
Buff: Soul Spear knockback increase, 2 > 3.
Buff: Soul Spear cooldown decrease, 2 > 1.5.
Buff: Static Satellite damage increase, 40 > 50.
Buff: Dagger Glove knockback increase, 1.5 > 3.
Buff: Dagger Glove damage increase, 45 > 50.
Buff: Demon Horns range scaling increase, 2*version > 4*version.
Buff: Demon Horns knockback increase, 4 > 6.
Buff: Demon Horns damage increase, 100 > 125.
Buff: Hunter's Bow knockback 0 > 2. 
Buff: Parasight knockback, 0 > 0.5.
Buff: Parasights can latch onto people better the faster it moves.
Buff: Parasights will now stay latched onto an enemy until it dies, no matter what.
Buff: Yoyo speed increased overall.
Buff: Walkman projectiles last twice as long.
Buff: Walkman projectiles speed up after hitting something.
Buff: Increased Snowglobe damage to 40.
Buff: Snowglobe cooldown from 4 seconds to 3 seconds.
Buff: Snowglobe is bigger by default.
Buff: Increased Plasma damage to 40.
Buff: Plasma Globe cooldown from 4 seconds to 3 seconds.
Buff: Increased Static Satellite damage to 50.
Buff: All frost slow effects last 2 seconds longer.
Buff: Elemental Crystal also increases Status Effect duration now.
Nerf: Overdrive levels now increase XP gain by 8% instead of 20% per level.
Nerf: Angel Wing Knockback, 8 > 6.
Nerf: Connect Call has been charged to Dial Tone, causing all XP to be magnetized towards you AFTER a boss kill rather than before.
Nerf: Reduced Flamethrower Flame hitbox.
Nerf: Flamethrower has 30% chance to ignite, instead of 50%.
Nerf: Crit Explosions no longer deal damage twice to the enemy that caused it.
Nerf: Telecom explosions can no longer trigger from C4 explosions.
Nerf: C4 damage adjusted from 5 + (3 * version) to 10 + (1 * version).
Nerf: Parasights damage reduced from 30 to 25.
Nerf: Parasights move slightly slower.
 
[h2]— - Fixes:[/h2]
Fix: Statue of Gamble's price and the amount it took were not aligned properly.
Fix: Leech Education can't proc when the game is slow/paused.
Fix: Fixed an issue with pausing the RPG memories on gamepad.
Fix: Clicking on a USB in the loadout screen will save your current selected skills.
Fix: Hopefully made it so that Autoupgrade wont pick a 'Nothing' upgrade if it appears.
Fix: Parasight showing it scaled with Cooldown when it didn’t.
Fix: Some weapons weren't being influenced by Weapon Transparency.
Fix: Fixed a bug where Crit Explosions would apply their damage to Telecom every time.
Fix: Fixed a bug where damage wouldn't be added to the stats if it killed the enemy, only if it 'hit' and left them alive.

[h2]— - VM or YYC?:[/h2]
Picayune Dreams runs on YYC, which is an export option in Gamemaker that cranks some extra performance but makes things a bit more 'locked down'. There are other very popular Gamemaker games that run on VM, and so some modding tools have been built around that. We'll be adding a VM build as an optional 'opt in' build in the betas setting after a few days have passed and any issues that arise with this big release are fixed - so keep your eyes open for that if you'd like to run that version for whatever reason.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/c5a1849fded2fe3bc8cb39f70c0b4e722cbf1505.png[/img]

[h1]COMING MARCH 7th[/h1]
Want to support more niche indie titles? [b]Schism[/b] is a challenging roguelite twin-stick RPG with gun modding, gods, leveling, and frequency-switching bullet hell action!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084300/Schism/

The combination of deep leveling and stat systems, full gun customization, deity worship, intense bullet hell combat, and difficult bosses make for a unique and highly replayable experience.

Be sure to add it to your [b]Wishlist[/b]. Thank you for all the support!
-Graeme (2 Left Thumbs)

It has been 365 Days since we put out Picayune Dreams. It's been such an amazing year. The best year of my life, even. It's a dream come true. Anyone who has been following our socials will know that we won the Gamemaker awards - Game Of The Year, which is all thanks to you.. its crazy unbelievable!! I wanted to make a post about that earlier when the trophy arrived, but it still hasn't. I think they had to take a bit of time getting it assembled, but its on the way and I'll make another post showing off pics when it gets here. Sorry about that! ːdos2skullː

Andyl4nd and Milky have been working hard on Endacopia, and I (Stepford) have been chipping in with a few coding bits over there. He put out this teaser, announcing that the game wouldn't be releasing this year - but to look forward to 2025! You should check it out:

[previewyoutube=bONU-buMNOk;full][/previewyoutube] 

[h1]Where is the Picayune Dreams update!?[/h1]
It's still being worked on! Since this is our first time making a game and releasing it to be sold, it's been a learning experience. I think it's been the first year of my life where I felt like I wasn't constantly gluing leaking pipes or running from an upcoming bill to pay -- but Picayune is still on my mind all the time, 24/7. When I'm in the shower, I push my head against the glass and imagine what I need to add or change or what people are saying online. 

I'm drawing a line in the sand. Unless some horrible computer exploding bug pops up, the update will be out on [b]January 31st.[/b] Perfect is the enemy of great and I want to release this to all of you. Mind you, if it does need to be delayed, I'll poke my head up to let you all know. Sometimes shit happens, there are still some screws that need tightening; so I hope you all won't be too angry if that happens. But a fire under my ass and some brewing excitement towards a specific goal date is exactly what I'm hungry for!

Fingers crossed the GOTY awards gets here soon, and I'll see you all soon! ːNekoː ːGunfireRebornloveː

notes.title: We need your HELP! + Update News!!
notes.content:
Hello! It's me, Stepford! I'm writing this newspost with good news! We are one of the top five nominated games for "Best Game" made using Gamemaker for 2024. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/3a22e307d6d6016784c96ac0690c620757e1640e.jpg[/img]

This is super awesome, and it's not something I could've imagined while making the game. I can't put into words how grateful I am for everyone who has played our game, I seriously couldn't ask for a better community. ːGunfireRebornloveː

The next stage of the Gamemaker Awards is all five of the games going against one another in a poll, which is where [b]I need to ask for your help![/b] [url=https://gamemaker.io/en/blog/gamemaker-awards-2024-voting]Here[/url] you can see all of the entries, and there's three different categories. We are competing for the Best Game, and that's where you will find us.

You can click [b][url=https://opr.as/GMA24-Vote]VOTE NOW![/url][/b] either on the bottom of that blog or right here and you'll be taken to a Google Form where all of the votes are being tallied. If you could head over there and chuck us a vote, it'd mean the world. ːSpRad_Rockː There's also other categories for the Most Anticipated Game and Best Gamemaker Tool, so if you recognize any of the entries in those you should def give them your support. ːsteamhappyː

* --- * 

[h2]WHERE IS THE UPDATE!?[/h2]

The update is still being worked on, but it's shaping up to be something I'm really happy with. There's a huge number of quality of life changes I can't wait for you all to get your hands on. 
- You can now see if your runs are 'flawless' by holding tab.
- Quick Restart.
- Save backups.
- All bosses automatically reduce weapon visibility like the final boss.
- A bunch of fixes to the canisters relating to their XP amounts and modifiers.
- Adjusting dialog speed setting. 
- Borderless window mode.
- Mute On Focus Loss setting. 
and a bunch more stuff that makes the game that much better. 

Another cool change is all of the settings that would help with lag prevention (lowspec, lategame autopickup, etc) have all been REMOVED and now there is a universal [b][ANTILAG][/b] variable that will increase or decrease to try and keep you at a stable framerate. That way you can start off every run with the game looking great and only have things get reduced/removed when the game requires it, instead of having to toggle them yourself when the time feels right. And the game has had a big optimization pass done on it.

You can also play Overdrive infinitely if you so wish, with the Max 5 cap being removed to allow you to continue earning more and more skillpoints. This means that people can compete with one another and really push the game to its limits, I did however put a 30 skillpoint cap on competing in Dailies, so that high ranking Daily players don't feel obligated to make it to Overdrive 74 or whatever just to keep up with one another. 

Another cool feature is people who have seen the alternate ending will be rewarded with Freeplay Mode, which makes a bunch of the debug functions easily accessible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/5d3093b52052c8229fca0ed12f4239a8b60f126a.gif[/img]

And this isn't mentioning the new weapons, skills and bosses I'll be adding with the update. It's gonna be sweet, I just feel bad it's taken so long! If there's anything else you'd like to see added, you're welcome to post them in the comments down below. Fingers crossed the next time I am writing a newspost like this, it's a date for the update itself. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HJWFsZ_YUc4]Or you can all bury me.[/url]

[u][h2]UPCOMING UPDATE[/h2][/u]
Hey! It's me, Stepford! I hope you all have been doing well! It's been a little while since I wrote an update like this, so I figured I'd pop my head out to update you all on how things are going on our end.

Since the last update, I took a long break to fully regain my energy from all the work that went into making the entire thing and the following month or two of post-release craziness. I struggled with motivation and focusing every time I'd go to work on the game so I kept putting it off over and over; but since the start of the month I've been working on it every single day. I feel a lot better and I'm having fun working on it! 

Meanwhile, Andyl4nd has been busy working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684630/Endacopia/]Endacopia[/url] and I've been occasionally helping with programming on that.  (Give it a wishlist to make him happy hehe :)) ) Milkypossum has been working on an album that you can see a teaser of [url=https://twitter.com/milkypossum/status/1789802034268438548]HERE[/url], it'll release on her Youtube, Spotify, etc. on June 7th! 

[b]WHAT can you expect from 1.0.1.0?[/b]
The focus for the update is to address some of the late game issues. The whole looping mechanic isn't particularly well balanced and fighting the same bosses that you have already been able to defeat (just with more health now) isn't all that enticing. As well as that, the update will add a small amount of content to just about every other corner of the game. New skills, new weapons, new enemies, new modifiers, new optional bosses. I want an update that's worth getting reinvested into the game, not just like... a few new toys you'll get bored of in an hour - which is why it's taking so long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/4688ea3a9784819b8912d54508954b2698a01a75.gif[/img]

[b]WHEN can you expect 1.0.1.0?[/b]
At this stage, it's hard to say! But the sooner I can get it out to you, the more happy both of us will be. I just want it to be BIG and tasty. What I will likely do is have the update release as a beta first, and then allow anyone to try it a week or two before it releases so that I can get some prerelease feedback and bugfixing done. I will probably do another announcement when that is ready, either here or in the Discord (which you can access in the main menu in the top left). 

Thank you all so much for the love, the praise, the fanart; all of it! I couldn't've imagined the game would do this well and every interaction I've had with one of you has been awesome. Even if I sometimes go radio-silent, I'm always watching ... :catsack:

If you have any questions about the game, the update or about me, post them below and I'll do my best to respond!

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/ec2820828b5c41855fc4e55bfaa319ee034dc697.png[/img]

Hello! ːNekoː Stepford here again. This is the third update to the game I'm putting out, aimed at adding a few suggestions and fixing a few bugs in the game! Please keep leaving suggestions and bugs in the the Community forums, they have been really helpful and I read them all. ːGunfireRebornloveː

[list]
[*] Added: X and Y coordinates to the HUD.
[*] Added: You can now toggle XP combining into Canisters, if you preferred the XP Text growing enormous and filling the screen.
[*] Added: If you want to play with both a controller AND a mouse at the same time, there is now an option in the Gamepad section to help with that.
[*] Added: A unique sound to the XP Canister pickup.  
[*] Added: You now revisit memories from the Loadout menu directly, instead of having to kill the boss again. This does make the skill a bit redundant, I might have to make it do something else instead. 
[*] Added: You can now instantly pick one of the three upgrades with the directional pad. (Turn this off in the Gamepad settings if you don't like it.) 
[*] Added: You can now play with Autoaim Deadzone, a setting in the Gamepad settings, to toggle autoaim if you're moving the analog stick or not. 
[*] Change: Made levelling up your profile slightly faster. 
[*] Change: XP Cans are now influenced by Late Game Auto XP, instantly adding their stored XP to your XP pool the moment it starts getting sucked.
[*] Change: Recolored XP Cannisters. 
[*] Change: Made it more obvious when your Curse has raised.
[*] Change: Made it more obvious which statues will raise your Curse. 
[*] Change: Biker has stun/slow immunity during some attacks.
[*] Change: Reverted Ghost Boss' blue bullets back to being red, like in the demo. 
[*] Change: Ghost Boss now forcibly lowers weapon alpha, just like the Final Boss.
[*] Change: Holding Tab to see your current upgrades now slows down the game.
[*] Change: Made explosive modifier less intensive. 
[*] Change: Modified Areas now have updated descriptions, to better inform the player that they also boost their stats.
[*] Change: Increased how long destination text stays on the screen, so people have more time to read said descriptions. 
[*] Change: Dark Matter Overload will no longer trigger if you are immortal.
[*] Change: Made it a lot more obvious when you are immortal/can't take damage.
[*] Change: Made some more HUD elements have black outlines. 
[*] Change: Debris that spawn during the final Boss will have an outline, making them easier to find.
[*] Change: Final Boss, Phase 1 teleports half as often. 
[*] Change: Several performance changes. 
[*] Change: Rainbowsplosion skill can no longer cause Statues to explode. 
[*] Change: Adjusted Yuki fight to be more like Gimmiko.
[*] Fix: Banned items would draw over your selected upgrade stats, now it draws behind them.
[*] Fix: Fixed a bug where the Biker would get stuck in place if the game paused/slowed down during their leaping phase.
[*] Fix: Telecom would damage the enemy that spawned the AoE, basically making it a 50% damage buff on everything that spawned it. The initial hit enemy is excluded now from the AoE damage. 
[*] Fix: Some weapons didn't have hitsounds assigned.
[*] Fix: Wibbler enemies were not having Peril speed applied to them properly. 
[*] Nerf: Statue of Gamble asks for +1 Reroll each time you use it. (1,2,3,4,etc.)
[*] Nerf: Sentry damage adjusted, (10+VERSION) > (15).
[*] Nerf: Missile Pack damage adjusted, (10 impact, 50 explosion) > (15 impact, 45 explosion).
[*] Nerf: XP Cannisters no longer gain the benefits of Unstable Enhancement skill. 
[*] Nerf: Stack Overflow now has a cooldown of 2.147 seconds.
[*] Buff: Stack Overflow now does 10,000 damage instead of 999.
[*] Buff: Snow Globe knockback increased, 0 > 0.75.
[*] Buff: Soul Spear damage increased, (40+VERSION) > (45+VERSION).
[*] Buff: Demon Wings damage increased, (3+VERSION) > (5+(VERSION*2)).
[*] Buff: Demon Horns radius increased, (48+VERSION) > (48+(VERSION*2)).
[*] Buff: Demon Horns activate radius is now visible on the player.
[*] Rework: Hunter's Bow no longer splits on contact, instead piercing through, homing to enemies near the cursor, able to hit the same enemy multiple times. Upgrading it now increases how long it stays around, instead of split count. This should help it stay relevant during bosses and late game.
[/list]

Quite a lot of changes here. I will say, with this many changes, there is bound to be a few new bugs that flew under my radar while making this patch. Even after just releasing it, I had to fix and issue relating to the music stopping because I tried changing some of the sound priorities to make late game's audiospace feel more "balanced" so you hear the stuff you need to, and the pointless stuff gets drowned out, but some stuff slipped through the cracks so if there is any important audio that doesn't play or gets cut off, please tell me. 

And then after I uploaded that build, I accidentally set the pitch to 10 making everything sound like chipmunks. So then I had to upload a new build. ːsteamhappyː fml this video game crap is hard. 

I will probably end up taking some time to make a public beta branch so everyone can playtest the next patch. Here are the latest demo updates. You can follow along more closely on the official [url=https://discord.gg/vEnpxNJxxx]Picayune Dreams Discord[/url]. Please keep in mind that this is just a [u]demo[/u] and there is no "real" late game currently. Looping through bosses is just for fun, and while we want that experience to be semi-balanced and enjoyable in it's own way, it is not reflective of the finished game's intended gameplay loop.

[h3][b]v0.3.0.4[/b] - February 1st, 2023[/h3]
- The amount of Peril earned per Mortality level now increases by Mortality itself, so it will start out buffing enemy HP at the same rate but slowly increase more and more.

notes.content:
Stepford has been working so hard on the demo, that I've completely fallen behind reporting these updates. They are all being shared over on the [url=https://discord.gg/vEnpxNJxxx]Picayune Dreams Discord[/url], but I want to have it documented here as well.

[h3][b]v0.3.0.2[/b] - January 28th, 2023[/h3]
- Power system has been changed into the new Peril system.
- Power used to lower your damage down to 25%, however it had little effect on fast hitting weaponry, could hit a cap and was too slow scaling. The Peril system works entirely opposite, where enemies get MORE health (about 5% every mortality level) after 25 mortality. This means all of the weapons keep their balance relevance as well as rewarding the player with more XP for playing that far.
- Fixed an issue where the weapons in the end screen would be printed twice.
- Halo is now drawn on one of the lowest layers. [i]Please tell me if this creates visual bugs anywhere[/i]!

- Slime Spike Cleansehit Nerf: 30 > 45

- Made Peril's enemy health boost even faster, around 15% HP per Mortality. 
- While in Peril, all multilevel generic enemies (skulls, souls, fish, gloves) will spawn at tier 3 every time.

- Tiptoe-ing while you have a shield recharging will also show your shield CD.
- Tiptoe-ing will also put a yellow glimmer underneath your cursor to make it easier to find.

- The lowest any of the passive skills can go is now 20% and the highest is 10,000%.

notes.title: Picayune Dreams Art Contest (on Newgrounds)
notes.content:
[h2]DEMO DEBUT[/h2]
Thank you for all the support, it was an outstanding first week! We're all a bunch of Newgrounds geeks, so our [i]sweep[/i] of the Weekly awards feels really special!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/381d34a13980f48823a2ad25cec53d962199ce60.png[/img]

[h2]ART CONTEST[/h2]
To celebrate the launch of this demo, and to pay it back to the Newgrounds community, we are hosting a [b]Picayune Dreams[/b] Art Contest! There are [u][b]$400+ worth of prizes[/b][/u] to be won.

Full contest details, rules, and submission requirements can be [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/bbs/topic/1518865]found in this thread[/url]. Yes, contest participation [u]requires a Newgrounds account[/u]. But if you're an artist, it's our firm belief that you should be building a Newgrounds portfolio anyways! I promise you'll meet some amazing people there :)

[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/bbs/topic/1518865][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/540ac5a5484b4c8e604b324a5ddba0efc06259b7.png[/img][/url]

[h2]HOTFIXES[/h2]
Plus Stepford has been hard at work squashing bugs and balancing the demo. All of your feedback has been outstanding! Posts made in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/vEnpxNJxxx]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/picayunedreams/]Subreddit[/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://picayunedreams.wiki.gg/wiki/Picayune_Dreams_Wiki]Wiki[/url] have all contributed to refining and improving the game, bit-by-bit. Thank you for that!

[h3]CHANGES[/h3]
- Eye2 Description Fixed
- Fixed a spelling mistake on the Death Screen.
- Added Mortality to Death Screen.
- Adjusted XP portion of Death Screen.
- Unique Pickups (grenades, magnets, usb, etc) now have 10 frames where they can't be picked up to properly initialize and also make it more visually clear when you acquire something point-blank range.
- When enemy bullets expire, they fade faster.
- Explosive Enemy Modifier explosions are now red instead of orange, to signify they are 'your' damage. The damaging "enemy" bullets remain orange however.
- Moved Firework Explosion Weapon onto the layer beneath players and enemies.
- Enemy bullets have had several optimization changes.

[h3]BALANCING[/h3]
- Eye2 Damage Nerf: (1 + version) > (version) 
- Demon Horns chomp hitbox increased by 'a LOT'.
- Demon Horns damage buff: 200 > 350
- C4 Damage Nerf: (5 + (5 x version)) > (5 x version)
- Halo Shield nerf: upon blocking an attack, it will now instead do 1 damage to you instead of 0; reducing the damage by 90% instead of blocking it ENTIRELY.
- Unique pickups currently delete after 60 seconds of being untouched, but now they also require the player to be over 2000 pixels away as well.

[url=https://twitter.com/Stepf0rd/status/1618820005730357250][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790996/4c5dccfca887db1d72e60e9ed54d48e52854d60c.png[/img][/url]

[h3]POWER[/h3]
Added a new difficulty adjusting system called 'POWER'. It will only show on the HUD after 30 Mortality (6 bosses), where each mortality level after that reduces your "power" by 1%. It starts at 100% and can go down to a minimum of 25%, reducing your overall damage in the process.

This won't effect anything for the majority of players but for those of you going for 'mega runs' hopefully this will fix the issue of you being too strong for your own good, having to manually close the game because it's become an endurance test - because that never feels good! This is more experimental so if you hate it, tell me.

You might need to restart Steam and validate Picayune files to force the update to download ASAP.

THANKS AGAIN!!
-Graeme
